summary: Iter-33 frontend-only verification of FirstTimeManualPill on the Dashboard. All 4 acceptance scenarios PASS, plus the marketing-claims jest regression remains 13/13 green.

test1_pill_renders_for_new_user.details: Registered fresh account via POST /api/auth/register {email, password, full_name} -> 200 with token+user. Stashed token in localStorage and navigated to /dashboard (waited 4s for quota). [data-testid='first-time-manual-pill']=1, [data-testid='first-time-manual-pill-link']=1 with href='/manual', [data-testid='first-time-manual-pill-dismiss']=1, localStorage.sai_manual_pill_dismissed_v1=null.

test2_pill_dismiss_persists.details: Clicked X on pill -> pill removed from DOM (count=0) and localStorage.sai_manual_pill_dismissed_v1='1'. After full page reload, pill stayed hidden (count=0) — flag persists across refresh.

test3_link_engagement_dismisses.details: Cleared localStorage flag, reloaded -> pill re-rendered (count=1). Clicked [data-testid='first-time-manual-pill-link'] -> URL became /manual and flag set to '1' immediately. Browser back to /dashboard -> pill count=0. Link click is correctly treated as engagement and dismisses the pill.

test4_quota_hides_pill_for_existing_user.details: Logged in as demo@stockai.io / demo1234 (analyses_this_week=4, confirmed via /api/quota response). With localStorage flag=null, [data-testid='first-time-manual-pill']=0 — quota signal alone hides the pill, matching spec.

test5_marketing_claims_jest_regression.details: cd /app/frontend && CI=1 yarn test --testPathPattern=marketing-claims --watchAll=false -> 13/13 passed in 0.352s, exit code 0.

critical_code_review_comments: FirstTimeManualPill.jsx is clean (~110 LOC). Initial state dismissed=true + useEffect on mount avoids first-paint flicker. Storage key versioned with `_v1` allows future re-promotion.

Wiring in DashboardPage.jsx is correct (line 11 import, line 673 render between TestUnlockBanner and quota banner) and component receives `quota` so the quota-based auto-hide works without an extra fetch.
Minor enhancement (non-blocking): could memoize `usedThisWeek` or extract a small `useFirstTimeManualPill` hook if reused on other pages — fine to leave as-is for this single-callsite feature.
test_credentials: demo@stockai.io / demo1234 used for quota-hides scenario. Fresh user registered dynamically via POST /api/auth/register with payload {email, password, full_name}.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 ephemeral test user 'manualpill+<timestamp>@test.io' / pass1234 via /api/auth/register for the new-user scenarios. Not deleted — feel free to ignore or prune.
context_for_next_testing_agent: FirstTimeManualPill is fully verified (renders for new user, hides via X dismiss + persists, hides via link engagement, hides via quota>0). NOTE for any future signup tests: /api/auth/register schema requires `full_name` (NOT `name`); sending `name` returns 422.
